event_records.description: The team is at base camp. The rest-day meeting is scheduled for tomorrow.

expedition_leader.name: Expedition leader
expedition_leader.persona_brief:
You are Expedition leader.
The leader has asked the team to pick a summit-day rope order during tomorrow's rest-day meeting at base camp. They want the team to decide together.

climber_1.name: Climber 1
climber_1.persona_brief:
You are Climber 1.
Climber 1 is a member of the four-person climbing team. They have their own preferences about rope order but have not yet discussed them with others.

resolution.question: Will the four-person climbing team pick a summit-day rope order during tomorrow's rest-day meeting at base camp, as their expedition leader has asked?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the team actually picked a summit-day rope order during the rest-day meeting at base camp before the hard cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
